# registry_storage_migration (Resource)

Triggers a one-shot storage backend migration. Create starts the job and polls until it reaches a terminal state. Update is blocked (any input change forces replacement). Delete attempts cancellation if the job is still running.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One-shot: create starts the migration and waits for a terminal status.
# Changing either config ID replaces the resource, which starts a new migration.
resource "registry_storage_migration" "s3_to_azure" {
  source_config_id = registry_storage_config.s3.id
  target_config_id = registry_storage_config.azure.id
  timeout_minutes  = 120
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_config_id` (String) UUID of the storage config to migrate from.
- `target_config_id` (String) UUID of the storage config to migrate to.

### Optional

- `timeout_minutes` (Number) Maximum time in minutes to wait for the migration to complete. Defaults to 60.

### Read-Only

- `completed_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the migration completed.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the migration job was created.
- `error` (String) Error message if the migration failed.
- `id` (String) UUID of the migration job.
- `objects_failed` (Number) Number of objects that failed to migrate.
- `objects_migrated` (Number) Number of objects successfully migrated.
- `objects_total` (Number) Total number of objects to migrate.
- `started_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the migration started.
- `status` (String) Migration status: 'pending', 'running', 'succeeded', or 'failed'.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the migration job was last updated.
